validated_results.title: Dietary factors and risk of prostate cancer: a case-control study in Ontario, Canada.
validated_results.reason: Original case-control study of dietary monounsaturated fat intake and incident histologically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma, with a qualitative risk result reported for monounsaturated fat.

extraction.population: Men with recent histologically confirmed adenocarcinoma of the prostate and age-frequency-matched male population controls

sample_size.excerpt: The study included 207 cases (51.4 percent of those eligible) and 207 controls (39.4 percent of those eligible), and information on dietary intake was collected from them by means of a quantitative diet history. There was a positive association between energy intake and risk of prostate cancer, such that men at the uppermost quartile level of energy intake had a 75 percent increase in risk.
sample_size.location: abstract, methods/results; total_n derived from reported group counts 207 + 207 = 414
